inbody.title: InBody report
inbody.hubIntro: Snap your InBody report or upload the PDF. We read the numbers, analyse them and build a workout & meal plan that fits your body.
inbody.readingHint: Extracting the numbers, just a few seconds.
inbody.aiUnavailable: We couldn't read the report automatically. Enter the key numbers manually (takes a minute).
inbody.notInbody: This doesn't look like an InBody report. Try a clearer photo of the full sheet.
inbody.howToRead: How to read an InBody report
inbody.reviewHint: Check the numbers before saving; fields marked * are needed for the analysis.
inbody.missing: Enter at least weight, muscle mass and body fat
inbody.applying: Building your plan from the report…
inbody.appliedDone: Done! Your new plan is based on your InBody report
inbody.segmentalHint: Percent of normal for each segment (100% = normal)
inbody.improvePlanHint: More accurate calories, protein and training focus

insight.ecw_high: Your ECW ratio {{v}} is above normal (0.36–0.39), which may indicate edema or fluid retention. Please see a doctor; your plan uses moderate intensity until then.
insight.visceral_high: Visceral fat is high ({{v}}). This fat around the organs carries more health risk, so we added regular cardio and cut sugars.
insight.visceral_normal: Visceral fat is in the normal range 👍
insight.fat_very_high: Body fat {{v}}% is well above range. Priority: gradual fat loss while protecting muscle.
insight.fat_high: Body fat {{v}}% is above the normal range.
insight.fat_low: Body fat {{v}}% is below range; don't cut food — focus on building.
insight.fat_normal: Body fat {{v}}% is in the normal range.
insight.muscle_low: Muscle mass {{v}} kg is below range; we raised protein and prioritised resistance training.
insight.muscle_high: Muscle mass {{v}} kg is excellent and above range 💪
insight.muscle_normal: Muscle mass {{v}} kg is in range.
insight.weak_segments: Below-normal segments: {{list}}. We added extra work for them.
insight.imbalance_arms: {{v}}% difference between arms; we added one-arm exercises starting with the weaker side.
insight.imbalance_legs: {{v}}% difference between legs; we added one-leg exercises starting with the weaker side.
insight.upper_weaker: Upper body is relatively weaker than lower; we increased upper-body volume.
insight.lower_weaker: Lower body is relatively weaker than upper; we added more leg work.
insight.target_one: Per your report: target weight {{target}} kg (fat {{fat}} kg, muscle {{muscle}} kg) — about {{weeks}} week.
insight.target_other: Per your report: target weight {{target}} kg (fat {{fat}} kg, muscle {{muscle}} kg) — about {{weeks}} weeks.
insight.targetNoWeeks: Per your report: target weight {{target}} kg (fat {{fat}} kg, muscle {{muscle}} kg).
insight.bmr: Measured BMR {{v}} kcal; we used it instead of an estimate and your calories won't go below it.

changes.calories: Calories from the BMR measured in your report
changes.protein: Protein based on your fat-free mass
changes.ecw: Moderate intensity and a medical check

inbody.disclaimer: Fitness guidance only, not a medical diagnosis.

health.title: Your Pulse
health.zone_none: Connect a watch to measure recovery
health.connectBody: We read your steps, sleep and heart data to score your recovery every morning and adapt today's workout — like WHOOP and Google Fit.
health.noWatch: Without a watch we only read steps from your phone. Recovery needs a watch that tracks heart rate and sleep.

adapt.red: Low recovery — we trimmed the volume and swapped cardio for an easy walk
adapt.yellow: Moderate recovery — one set less on accessory lifts
adapt.green: High recovery — go push it today 💪

health.privacy: Your raw health data stays private. Friends only see your step count, for step challenges.
health.unavailable: No health data source on this device. On Android, install Health Connect from Google Play.
health.watches_ios: Apple Watch · WHOOP · Oura · Garmin · Fitbit
health.watches_android: Pixel Watch · Galaxy Watch · Fitbit · WHOOP · Garmin · Oura
health.via_ios: Anything that writes to the Health app on iPhone
health.via_android: Anything that writes to Health Connect on Android
health.howBody: We compare this morning's HRV and resting heart rate with your personal 30-day baseline, and add your sleep performance versus your need. 67%+ = green, 34–66% = yellow, under 34% = red. Strain (0–21) comes from time in heart-rate zones (or active calories when zones are missing).

store.title: Partner Store
store.intro: Products from local sports brands — you buy directly on the brand's site.
store.homeBody: Run a sports brand? Show your products to the ARQ community
store.addYoursBody: Register your sports brand and add products. We review it, then it goes live for everyone.
store.redeemBody: Soon you'll trade points for discounts and products from partner brands. Your points: {{n}}.
store.empty: The first brands are coming. Have a brand? Be the first store.
store.buyNote: Purchase and delivery happen on the brand's own site. ARQ only showcases products.
store.join1: Fill in your brand details and your website or Instagram.
store.join2: The ARQ team reviews it within 48 hours.
store.join3: Once approved, add products and your store is visible to everyone.
store.name: Brand name
store.taglinePh: e.g. Training wear built for Riyadh summers
store.agree: I confirm the products are genuine and licensed, and that sales, delivery and returns are the brand's responsibility.
store.submittedBody: We'll review it within 48 hours. You can add products now; they go live after approval.
store.status_pending: Under review — visible to everyone once approved
store.status_approved: Your store is live for all users
store.status_rejected: Not approved — update your details and contact us
store.noStoreYet: You don't have a store yet
store.addFirstProduct: Add your first product: photo, name, price and buy link
store.rules: Up to 60 products. Tap a product to edit, hide or delete it.
store.productUrlHint: Leave empty to open the brand's website

exercise.dragHint: Drag to rotate · tap a muscle to highlight it
exercise.mapHint: Muscles worked in this exercise · follow the steps below for the movement

beta.intro: You're one of our first testers 🙌 Report any bug, idea or design note here — it reaches us directly with your app version and device.
beta.ph_bug: What happened? What did you expect? Which screen?
beta.updateUnavailable: Instant updates only work in installed builds
beta.privateNote: Your report goes only to the app owner — no other user can see it. We review it and update its status here.

coach.title: ARQ Coach
coach.subtitle: Powered by AI
coach.hello: Hey! What are we doing today?
coach.intro: Ask for a workout by muscle, time and place, ask about any exercise or meal, or tell me which screen to open.
coach.placeholder: Type a request… e.g. 45-min back workout
coach.offline: Quick reply without AI (offline or not enabled)

workout.title: Workout
workout.nothingLogged: You haven't logged any sets. Delete this session?
workout.firstTime: First time logging this exercise — we'll compare from next session
workout.compareTitle: Compared with your last similar workout
workout.noPrevious: This is your first session of this kind — next time you'll see the comparison here 💪
workout.legend: Numbers = best set (weight × reps). Change = volume (weight × reps across all sets) vs the last time you did the same exercise. 🏆 = new personal record (highest estimated 1RM).
workout.historyEmpty: No logged workouts yet. Start from your plan or the AI coach.
workout.historyHint: Every session is compared automatically with your last session for the same muscles.
workout.resume: You have an open workout — resume
workout.gapKg: {{kg}} kg more at the same reps to beat {{name}}
workout.friendsBoardHint: Per exercise: the top 3 lifts among your friends (weight × reps) and your place. Only friends see these numbers.
workout.friendsBoardEmpty: Add friends to compare your lifts with theirs on every exercise
workout.setsPerMuscleHint: Last 4 weeks vs the 4 before — usually aim for 10–20 weekly sets per muscle
workout.topLiftsHint: Estimated 1RM bars for recent sessions, and change vs 4+ weeks ago

programs.title: Ready programs
programs.intro: Proven training programs you can adopt as your weekly plan in one tap — every exercise has a 3D demo, and gets logged and compared with last time.
programs.keepsMeals: Your meal plan and daily targets stay as they are.
programs.needPlan: Create your plan first (so we keep your meals and targets), then adopt the program.
programs.adopted: Done! The program is now your weekly plan 💪

social.noProgramsSelf: Publish your first program — you get 10 points each time someone adopts it
social.programsLocked: Publishing programs unlocks at “{{rank}}”. Keep showing up 💪
social.noTipsSelf: Share your first tip with the community
social.lockedBody: Unlocks at “{{rank}}” — {{n}} points to go. Earn points from gym check-ins, workouts and steps.
social.communityIntro: Programs published by Pro-rank members and verified coaches. Adopt any of them as your weekly plan in one tap.
social.noCommunityPrograms: No published programs yet. Members unlock publishing at Pro rank.
social.newProgramIntro: Build your program: add days and exercises from the 3D library, then set sets, reps and rest. Anyone can adopt it once published.
social.programDescPh: Who is it for? What does it focus on?
social.publishNote: It shows on your profile and under Community. You can delete it anytime.
social.err_title: Give the program a name (3+ characters)
social.err_dayEmpty: One of the days has no exercises
social.err_reps: Reps must be a number or range like 8-12
social.newTipIntro: Share something you learned that helps others. It shows on your profile and in the Tips tab.
social.tipPh: e.g. Don’t rush the weight; lock in technique for two weeks, then add 2.5 kg.
social.noTipsYet: No tips yet. Members unlock tips at Advanced rank.
social.coachNote: Certified coaches get the ✓ badge and can publish right away. Contact us to verify your account.

presence.hiddenCount_other: +{{count}} here in hidden or friends-only mode

presence.visHint_friends: Only your friends see your check-ins.
presence.visHint_hidden: Nobody sees your check-ins. Points and streaks still count.
presence.noComments: No comments yet — cheer them on
presence.commentPh: Write a comment… e.g. Keep it up 💪

presence.hereNow_other: {{count}} people at the gym right now

presence.checkInToSee_other: {{count}} people at the gym now · check in to see who

chat.title: Messages
chat.rule: Chat with people you follow mutually

chat.empty: No chats yet. Follow people — once they follow you back you can message each other.
chat.emptyWithContacts: Start a chat with someone above 👆
chat.locked: You can message {{name}} once you follow each other.
chat.waitFollowBack: You follow {{name}} — waiting for them to follow back.

owner.noAccess: This page is only for the app owner
owner.notePh: Your note (the reporter sees it)… e.g. fixed in the next build

clubs.priceNote: Prices are updated by the gym or the ARQ team — confirm the final price when you subscribe.

checkin.auto: We detect the gym from your location

checkin.outside: You're not inside a gym right now
checkin.nearestLine: Nearest gym: {{name}} ({{d}} away). Check in once you are inside.
checkin.noneNearLine: No gyms found near you. Search for yours by name below.
checkin.weakGps: Weak signal indoors. Move near the entrance or turn on Wi-Fi, then locate again
checkin.locationOff: Location services are off. Turn them on in Settings
checkin.timeout: We couldn't get your location. Please try again
checkin.how1: Open this page while you are inside the gym. We verify your location (you need to be inside, about 200 m from its map location).
checkin.how2: You earn 10 points for your first check-in of the day at a verified gym ✓, plus 5 more if you train 45 minutes and check out.
checkin.how3: Your gym isn't listed? Search for it by name below and we'll fetch it from the map, or add it at your location.
checkin.savedMain: This is now your main gym ✓
checkin.notListed: Can't find your gym? Search by name

checkin.mapDown: Map search isn't available right now. These results are from gyms we already know.

food.empty: Nothing logged today. Add your meals and calories are counted automatically.
food.noResults: Not found — log it as a custom food.
food.customHint: Don't know the calories? Enter protein, carbs and fat and we'll calculate them.
food.customNeed: Enter a name and calories (or macros).

notif.title: Notifications
notif.emptyHint: When someone follows you, comments on your post or invites you to a challenge, you'll see it here.
notif.followMutual: {{name}} followed you back — you can message each other now
notif.prefsIntro: Choose what reaches your phone. Everything stays here in the bell either way.
notif.cat_socialHint: New followers, friend requests, a friend arriving at the gym
notif.cat_activityHint: Likes and comments on your posts and check-ins, program adoptions
notif.cat_progressHint: Challenge invites, wins and new ranks
notif.cat_nudgesHint: Gym, workout and meal reminders — and when a friend beats you to it
notif.cat_offersHint: New offers and prices at your gym or its chain
notif.phoneOff: Off for this app. Turn them on in your phone settings.
notif.phoneAskHint: Get notified when someone messages you or invites you to a challenge, even when the app is closed.
notif.phoneUnsupported: Phone notifications only work on a real device.
notif.askBody: We'll let you know when someone messages you, follows you, invites you to a challenge, or your gym posts an offer. You can change this anytime.

nudge.title: Motivation notifications
nudge.buttonHint: Write messages that push members to the gym, workouts and meals — for men and women
nudge.intro: Write the notifications that motivate members to go to the gym. Each time, the app picks a random active text matching the member's gender and language. At most 3 a day per person, only between 8 AM and 10 PM.
nudge.when_gym: Sent an hour before their usual gym time (or 5 PM), if they haven't checked in today.
nudge.when_friend: Sent instead of “Gym” when a friend (mutual follow) checked in today and they didn't. {friend} = the friend's name.
nudge.when_streak: Sent at 9 PM to anyone with a 2+ day streak who hasn't checked in today.
nudge.when_workout: Sent at 9 AM when their plan has a workout today and they haven't started it.
nudge.when_meal: Sent at 1 PM if they haven't logged any food today.
nudge.noActive: ⚠️ No active Arabic text for {{who}}, so they won't get this type.
nudge.friendGender: The friend who beat them (for the Arabic verb form)
nudge.vars: Tap a variable to add it; the app fills it in for each member:
nudge.testSent: Sent to you ✅ Check the bell 🔔
nudge.empty: No texts here yet. Add the first one 👆
nudge.tooShort: Write a title and a message (at least 3 characters)

insight.stressEmpty: Stress is calculated from your heart rate through the day. Wear your watch and the chart will show up here.
insight.calibratingLong_one: Learning your normal range. Sleep with your watch {{n}} more night to complete it.
insight.calibratingLong_other: Learning your normal range. Sleep with your watch {{n}} more nights to complete it.
insight.monitorNoData: No overnight readings from your watch yet (breathing, oxygen, temperature). Make sure it records them in {{source}}.
insight.monitorOk: All your metrics are within your normal range ({{a}}/{{b}}). You're good.
insight.monitorOut: {{list}} outside your usual range tonight. Could be fatigue, poor sleep or a cold coming on. Take it easy today.
insight.dashHint: Big number = today · small = your 30-day average (HR zones: the week before)
insight.fitnessNeedData: We need a few days of watch data (resting heart rate or VO₂ Max) to estimate your fitness age.
insight.fitnessNeedAge: Add your birth year in your profile to calculate your fitness age.
insight.fitnessBasisVo2: Based on VO₂ Max and resting heart rate.
insight.fitnessBasisVitals: Based on resting heart rate, steps and sleep.
insight.fitnessNote: A motivational estimate, not a medical diagnosis.
